title: migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql never creates the secrets table in this environment
summary: Discovered during RELEASE-VALIDATOR Step 6 of the ISS-0074 fix run. migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql wraps its CREATE TABLE secrets in a DO block guarded by `IF to_regclass('instance_projections') IS NULL THEN RETURN`. Direct psql inspection of both r-co-db-1 (bpm_dev) and r-co-db_test-1 (bpm_test) shows no `secrets` table exists in any schema (public or tenant_default), even though `instance_projections` and `webhook_subscriptions` both exist under the `tenant_default` schema. zig build migrate reports the migration file as already applied (skip). The guard's to_regclass() call appears to resolve against a search_path that does not include tenant_default at migration-apply time, so the guard condition is met (returns NULL, treated as instance_projections missing) and the migration body silently no-ops without ever creating the table it is meant to create.

root_cause.details: to_regclass('instance_projections') resolves relative to the active search_path when the migration DO block executes. If the migration runner does not set search_path to include tenant_default (or the relevant tenant schema) before running this migration, the guard incorrectly concludes the prerequisite table is missing and returns early, permanently skipping secrets table creation on that run. Because the migrations tracking table still records the file as applied, it will never be retried without a manual intervention (either fixing the guard or manually re-running the DO block body).

files_to_change: migrations/GBL-100_exp501_secrets.sql or a new corrective migration

occurrences.context: Discovered incidentally while verifying ISS-0074's acceptance criterion about pre-existing plaintext secrets rows during RELEASE-VALIDATOR Step 6 -- found the secrets table does not exist at all in dev or test DBs.
